about: UltralightRecs starter catalog (2026-10-23): current ultralight backpacking tents and shelters, backpacks, sleeping pads, and quilts and sleeping bags. Every value was read on 2026-10-23 from the maker's own page linked in sources; anything not read there is blank. Added on 2026-10-26: products with 3+ held first-hand reviews (older models sourced from the maker's archived page on web.archive.org), Granite Gear and Mountain Laurel Designs packs and shelters, and four new categories (cook kits, water filters, trekking poles, rain jackets), each value read on 2026-10-26 from the linked page. One entry per model as the maker names it; where a model comes in several sizes, volumes or temperature ratings the maker sells under one name, they are listed in surface and the weight names the size it is for. Columns: shape = category, balance = type, surface = capacity (people or litres) or warmth (R-value or temperature), core = main material, weight = weight as the maker states it.
